title: Waitlist Hero
build_command: docker run --rm -u 1000:1000 -e HOME=/tmp -v "$PWD:/work" -w /work --entrypoint sh louislam/uptime-kuma:2 -c 'npm ci && npm run build'

checks.production_build: passed: TypeScript and Vite 6.4.5; dist/index.html exists
checks.browser: passed: Chromium via Playwright Core, production files served at required subpath
checks.button_states: passed: keyboard focus, Login hover text, CTA hover opacity 0.9 and active scale 0.95

notes: Original video and portrait successfully downloaded from the exact prompt URLs. Inter 400/500/600 hosted locally. No asset substitution or reference extraction.
Publication base: /motionsites-results/waitlist-hero/. Not deployed or pushed.
Single App.tsx contains the page, reusable Orb, frame capture and canvas slicing. No video currentTime assignments.
Buttons implement specified visual interactions. The prompt supplies no login/waitlist destinations or backend; these are not invented.

Busy software-rendered Chromium captured 24 desktop and 23 mobile presented frames from the 7.04-second source during the final check. Reverse progression is verified; complete encoded-frame capture and physical-device smoothness are not established.
Vite emits a static local inter.css URL notice at build time; production browser checks verify that the stylesheet and fonts resolve correctly.
README.md contains build, verification, provenance and limitations. Ready means available for review, not live.
